sections.label: Water supply and climate change
sections.summary: Water supply is planned to be adequate, but resilience against climate change uncertainties needs enhancing.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: While we have planned ahead to ensure that our water supply is adequate, we need to enhance our resilience against the uncertainties brought about by climate change.

sections.label: PUB school water rationing exercises
sections.summary: PUB collaborated with five schools to conduct water rationing exercises during Singapore World Water Day celebrations this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: As such, the Public Utilities Board (PUB) collaborated with five schools to conduct water rationing exercises this year during the Singapore World Water Day celebrations.

sections.label: Water conservation outreach and efficiency measures
sections.summary: PUB has included water conservation in Primary 3 social studies, run outreach programmes, mandated water efficiency labelling and minimum standards, and worked on the Yuhua Smart Enabled Homes Trial.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: In addition, PUB has worked with the Ministry of Education to include water conservation topics in the social studies syllabus for Primary 3 students.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: As for the wider community, PUB has been carrying out extensive outreach and educational programmes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: We have also mandated water efficiency labelling and minimum standards to help consumers make more informed purchasing decisions and adopt more water-efficient fittings and appliances.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: For example, PUB is working with the Housing and Development Board (HDB) and the Infocomm Development Authority (IDA) on the Smart Enabled Homes Trial in Yuhua estate for 2016-2017, and this will provide households with hourly water consumption data and water saving tips, and alert them on anomalies in water usage.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Given these outreach programmes, both at schools and in the community, it may not be necessary to conduct water rationing exercises with households at the moment.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: The responsibility of water conservation does not fall on households alone.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: We have mandated the submission of Water Efficiency Management Plan (WEMP) for large water users in the non-domestic sector.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: PUB will study the data collected from these plans and explore the potential for water efficiency benchmarks and good practice guidelines for the different sectors.
